title: World clock
summary: Time, date and the city clocks the console shows; read-only, no state of its own.

surfaces.web: N/A(web parity is decided in WO-0002)

notes: M1 shim: the route keeps the exact 1.1.1 body (world_clock.pulse()). Its weather lookup is cached in memory only, so this module owns no state and its gate is 'none'. The clock pane moves into the module in Phase M2; until then the pane is the existing markup and no DOM id has changed. limb_count 0 is correct: the world clock is not a model tool.
